author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Since the beginning of The Walking Dead franchise, KNB EFX has been responsible for the look, design, and fabrication of its walker zombies. Adam tours the KNB EFX workshop to learn the history and evolution of the walker design, including the classic zombie references that the studio sneaked into the show. 

Learn more about KNB EFX's work at https://www.knbefx.com/
Why Movie Werewolves Look Like This: https://youtu.be/LM0HCaSTlAw
